ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
numpy:
- '2'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: pymca
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "5.9.7"

package:
  name: pymca
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/pymca5/pymca5-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a7de9ec86df93cde6aac931521208c5493df04eacf6f9364248b52879707eaa4

build:
  number: 1
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-cache-dir -vvv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
        - numpy
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
  host:
    - fisx >=1.1.6
    - h5py
    - numpy
    - pip
    - python
    - cython
    - setuptools
  run:
    - fisx >=1.1.6
    - h5py
    - matplotlib-base >3.5
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - PyMca5
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Mapping and X-Ray Fluorescence Analysis
  homepage: http://pymca.sourceforge.net
  repository: https://github.com/silx-kit/pymca
  documentation: http://www.silx.org/doc/PyMca/latest/tutorials.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - sergey-yaroslavtsev
    - woutdenolf
    - tschoonj
